Once upon a time in a wide, there was a little girl called Sally. Sally liked to go on adventures, and she always looked forward to being there before.

One day, Sally decided to explore a wide field near her home. As she walked through, she noticed something on the grass below her foot! It was a big, wide pond with lots of happy creatures.

Sally was feeling very guilty, so she decided to peek in the corner of the pond. When she looked to the pond, she saw a fish. The fish was eating the food from her hands. Sally felt a bit guilty
